description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare  and Excise Duty on Motor Vehicles for the transport of goods shall be payable w.e.f. 18.08.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which establishes new excise duty rates on specific goods (motor vehicles and motorcycles). It amends previous regulations and rescinds an earlier gazette notification. This content fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and modifications to existing legal provisions related to taxation and excise duties.
